Watts made this hymn from Psalm 66:13–20, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

13I will enter Your house with burnt offerings; I will fulfill my vows to You— 14the vows that my lips promised and my mouth spoke in my distress. 15I will offer You fatlings as burnt offerings, with the fragrant smoke of rams; I will offer bulls and goats. Selah 16Come and listen, all you who fear God, and I will declare what He has done for me. 17I cried out to Him with my mouth and praised Him with my tongue. 18If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened. 19But God has surely heard; He has attended to the sound of my prayer. 20Blessed be God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld from me His loving devotion! PSALM 66:13–20 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 66
Now shall my solemn vows be paid To that Almighty power, That heard the long requests I made In my distressful hour. STANZA I
